reason: The only S0-to-S1 change in xmlParseCatalogPI adds a comment describing xmlCatalogAddLocal error-reporting limitations; it does not alter any entry point, API call, parser state, configuration, input semantics, control flow, or attack surface. H0 already exercises parser entry points such as xmlCtxtReadMemory, xmlParseChunk, and xmlReaderForMemory with fuzz-controlled document data and options, so no material harness gap is established or introduced.
evidence: In parser.c, the executable statement ctxt->catalogs = xmlCatalogAddLocal(ctxt->catalogs, URL) is identical across S0 and S1.
All added lines are inside a /* ... */ comment immediately before xmlCatalogAddLocal.
fuzz/xml.c supplies fuzz-derived docBuffer, docSize, docUrl, and opts to xmlCtxtReadMemory and also exercises push-parser and reader interfaces.
Several H0 initializers call xmlInitializeCatalog when LIBXML_CATALOG_ENABLED is defined.
recommended_action: No harness maintenance is needed for this commit.
